skills.description: This skill should be used when a user provides a PRD (Product Requirement Document) for automated review and evaluation. It applies Uber's First-Pass PRD evaluation framework to assess PRD quality across 6 core dimensions, detect common anti-patterns, classify launch readiness, and generate structured, actionable feedback with prioritized action items. Trigger phrases include: 评审PRD, review this PRD, 帮我评审需求文档, PRD评审, review PRD document, 评估这个需求, 审查产品需求文档, or any request to evaluate/assess a product requirement document.
skills.description_zh: 当用户提交产品需求文档（PRD）以供自动化评审和评估时，应使用此技能。该技能采用Uber的初步PRD评审框架（《Lessons from Building a First-Pass AI PRD Reviewer at Uber》），从6个核心维度评估PRD质量，识别常见反模式，判断上线准备度，并生成结构化、可操作的反馈意见及优先级排序的行动项。触发短语包括：评审PRD、review this PRD、帮我评审需求文档、PRD评审、review PRD document、评估这个需求、审查产品需求文档，或任何要求评估/审查产品需求文档的请求。
skills.name: PRD评审
